text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience, and I’d love to support your Amazon private label ventures.

In my Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports, helping reduce monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. In my Marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare attribution models, which led to 18% of the ad budget being reallocated.

I bring strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I can help with product research support, supplier data tracking, listing analysis, inventory monitoring, and reporting to keep operations organized and informed.

I’d be glad to discuss how I can add value to your team.
